test_objective: Check that you can retrieve a subscription

test_cases.name: 030_03_01 Retrieve Subscription
test_cases.doc: Check that you can retrieve a subscription
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/subscriptions/{id}'
        method set to 'GET'
        Subscription Retrieve with the following data: and
    Query Parameter: id set to '${subscription_id}' and
    Query Parameter: context set to 'https://forge.etsi.org/rep/cim/ngsi-ld-test-suite/-/raw/develop/resources/jsonld-contexts/ngsi-ld-test-suite-compound.jsonld'
}
